units.source_text: 当天夜里，他睡在二楼的房间里。

en.t: That night, he slept in the room on the second floor.

units.source_text: 这房间原本是父亲的房间。

en.t: This room had originally been his father's room.

units.source_text: 早先父亲总在这房间里，锁上房门，闷在里面，净是思考积攒金钱的事。

en.t: In earlier days, his father was always in this room, locking the door and shutting himself inside, thinking of nothing but saving up money.

units.source_text: 他的枕头下面放着八十万元。

en.t: Under his pillow lay eight hundred thousand yuan.
